E1.description: Single commanded net transfer in joint2, the unique largest translational Jacobian-column norm at the frozen midpoint. All coordinates match actual initial velocity.

E2.description: Coordinated j2(+),j4(-),j6(+) transfer through the serial chain, testing coupling.

E3.description: j3(+) andj5(-) outbound followed by a return to actual initial q; zero reference velocity/acceleration at the fixed .5s turning point; mathematically C2.

plan.reference_screen: After each actual P1 endpoint, fixed101 nodes including phasejoin; reference physical q/v/h/psi1/manip checks. This is not a Stage1 or full-torque certificate. Screen failure retainsFAIL and prevents motion.

startup_controller.name: P1-r3 sampled computed-torque static-midpoint startup only
startup_controller.design_derivation: Nominal frozen inverse-dynamics double-integrator ZOH: Kp=(1-r)^2/Delta0^2, Kd=(3-2r-r^2)/(2*Delta0), r=0.25, Delta0=1 ms. Fixed same gains in every cell. These poles are a nominal design rationale, not a nonlinear/sample-hold stability certificate.
startup_controller.gain_selection: New startup-only engineering choice frozen before any r3 test; r2 contains no numerical computed-torque proposal. No gain sweep or pass-conditioned selection.
startup_controller.execution_controller: Unchanged approved Slotine-Li Lambda=5/s and kappa=10/s; startup law ends at measured t=0.

execution_sampling.formula: r_k=unchanged Slotine-Li request(q_k,qd_k,reference(t_k),dhat_k). u_0=r_0; u_k=r_k+0.5*(r_k-r_{k-1}) for k>=1. The complete current-state hard QP filters u_k; actual QP torque is ZOH.
execution_sampling.rationale: The r3 request frozen at the start of each interval has first-order control-period error. The two-step causal quadrature approximates the interval-average request with second-order consistency for smooth requests; bootstrap contributes an O(Delta^2) global error. This is not a nonlinear stability proof.
execution_sampling.history: Fresh execution instance in each cell; no preparation-controller history, no future reference sample/state/estimate or true disturbance. One proposal per attempted QP. Endpoint solve reused for first torque. Failure ends cell, no retry or reused history.
execution_sampling.diagnostics: Log original continuous request, previous request, sampling correction and update index. QP intervention measured against the actual AB2 request; sampling correction separately reported to avoid hiding the controller change.
execution_sampling.additional_criterion: Both original C4 and finer-confirmation cohorts must pass all four fixed-factor comparisons and both disclosed diagonals. This strengthens rather than relaxes the old refinement rule.

plan.observer_semantics: Coupled continuous q,qd,z RK4 using measured stage states and exact actually applied held torque. No reset at zero. Plant disturbance uses signed physical time; envelope elapsed=t+T_pre.

fixed_acceptance_thresholds.zero_intervention_kind: APPROVED NUMERICAL DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; not certified solver error
fixed_acceptance_thresholds.T29_source: Action_2026-10-31.docx Protocol v1.0 §8.1; no original T29 worksheet present in Tasks_2026.xlsx

plan.entrance_gate: Actual post-P1 h/psi1/speed/manip/lasttau, legitimate varpi(t+Tpre), necessary joint-position and speed pairs, full43-row strict QP. No truth input for control. Endpoint solve reused for first actual torque.
plan.acceptance: All four complete cells and raw strictstate/observer/QP/terminal checks, original four refinementmetrics on all4 edges plus2 diagonals, original thresholds, lossless trace roundtrip and unchanged r4 mathematical auditor with codec-only loader. No zero-test/missing-cell GO.
plan.failure_semantics: Retain original v1 failures byte-identically. New v2 still stops on any raw negative, non-solved status, T29 failure, physical or observer failure. No retry, clipping or replacement of reference/duration/amplitude/gains/acceptance thresholds.
plan.sampler_reporting: Per applied update retain r,u,tau, u-r,tau-u,tau-r; max/RMS Euclidean and component norms, RMS at constantDelta is time-weighted over the reported executed horizon. No zero-continuous-intervention inference from small tau-u.
plan.data_codec: Lossless typed columnar ZIP trace archive with canonical JSON SHA256 and documented decoder; original scientific scalar values retained. No pickle/lossy rounding.
plan.evidence_level: EXECUTED LOCALLY / LEVEL2_NUMERICAL only when actually run; no trueODE or sampled-delay certificate; signaturesblank
plan.QP_time_budget_scope: One cold versioned GuardedHardQP query per update in isolated per-cell worker; timeout UNKNOWN/no actuation/no retry. Numerical changes explicitly declared above, not an unchanged original solver claim.
